questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.tutor: Ampere (A) is the SI unit of electric current.

questions.question: What is the phase relationship in a purely resistive circuit?
questions.tutor: In a pure resistor, voltage and current are in phase (θ=0).

questions.question: In a purely inductive circuit, current ______ voltage by 90°.
questions.tutor: In pure inductor, current lags voltage by 90°.

questions.question: In a purely capacitive circuit, current ______ voltage by 90°.
questions.tutor: In pure capacitor, current leads voltage by 90°.

questions.question: What is the power factor of a purely inductive load?
questions.tutor: Pure inductive load has PF = 0 lagging.

questions.question: What is the power factor of a purely capacitive load?
questions.tutor: Pure capacitive load has PF = 0 leading.

questions.question: What is the real power formula in AC circuit?
questions.tutor: Real power P = Vrms × Irms × cosθ.

questions.question: What is the unit of reactive power?
questions.tutor: Reactive power Q is measured in Volt-Ampere Reactive (VAR).

questions.question: What is Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL)?
questions.tutor: KCL: total current entering a node equals total leaving.

questions.question: What is Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL)?
questions.tutor: KVL: sum of voltages around any closed loop equals zero.
